body:
New bounded engine source task RES05a, independent of held Document Save As acceptance. A pure estimator/preflight is source-reviewed at origin/codex/psd-admission-estimate 142d1d6b (tests ee7cf43e/c8428cc3/31de6e87; product186c9050 +docs9e9692b3 +fix142d1d6b). It is UNRUN while A full Swift gate occupies lane. Read that exact source and /main board; prepare a narrow B-owned FFI pre-rasterization hook on a separate source branch based on current main with only required estimator source, not any unaccepted Save As branch ancestry.
Goal: RasterizedPsdCopyOperation.run_inner takes immutable Arc<DocState> snapshot, then rejects unavoidable PSD composite format/layout errors before rasterize_layers/evaluation/tempfile. Use compositor::psd::estimate_rasterized_psd_copy and checked counts from that SAME snapshot for enabled smart-object stacks and emitted Pixel/Text/Shape/SmartObject leaves, recursively through Groups. New Document::new(copy) PSD output has mandatory merged alpha (retained_merged_alpha=true), unlike an imported opaque PSD; source-reviewed correction covers this distinction. Estimate is modeled pixel payload only, NOT measured RSS/cap. No guessed hard process budget/permit policy, no new API bindings, no expensive allocation. Preserve cancellation checks, physical output persistence guarantees and native operation drain. Tests should be tiny meaningful injected-counter or sentinel controls proving rejection before evaluator/tempfile and success path still drains; no oversized image allocation. Keep test-only and source commits separate where useful.
This is SOURCE-ONLY on B: no cargo/swift/build/apps/benchmarks, heartbeat remains paused and resource hold unchanged. Return exact patch/test commits and scope. A owns all integration/test/main. Existing Document trace refinement65266 already accepted and queued for next GUI lane; preserve both trace histories and do not change lifecycle without new failing evidence.
